verdict.rationale: Galileo offers an official MCP server that lets users create datasets, run experiments, and set up prompt templates from a dev environment, which enables natural-language/agentic interaction via MCP-compatible clients, plus natural-language feedback for metric tuning. However, there's no evidence of a chat-style natural-language command interface within Galileo's own console/product for general operation (e.g., 'create a project' or 'run this trace' via plain English), so this is enabled indirectly through MCP tooling rather than a native NL command layer. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party natural-language chat/command interface in the Galileo console itself, and independent/hands-on confirmation that MCP-driven natural-language commands work reliably end-to-end.
